assessment.title: Assessment
assessment.inheritedHint: The assessment settings are configured once for the whole milestone and apply to all of its user stories, because one submission is graded for all of them at once.

userStoryExercise.problemStatementHint: All dates and repositories are inherited from the milestone. You can reference test cases from the milestone's test repository, e.g. [task][Implement BubbleSort](testBubbleSort,testBubbleSortHidden).
